 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Rajeev Kumar Singh, Adv.
 Mr. Prabhajot Singh, Adv.

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ram Anurag Singh, App
 For the Informant : Mr. Birendra Kumar, Adv.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Nawneet Kumar
 Pandey
3 09-05-2025 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned counsel for the Informant.

2. The petitioner is seeking regular bail in connection with Nanpur P.S. Case No. 280 of 2023,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 354, 376, 504/506, 34 of the IPC.

3. Allegedly, on the false pretext of marriage, the petitioner had been establishing physical relationship with her, as a result of which, the victim is carrying pregnancy of four months and while the victim asked the petitioner to solemnized marriage, he refused to accede it.
4.
It has jointly been submitted that for exploring the possibility of solution of the dispute between the parties some time should be given.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.13712 of 2025(3) dt.09-05-2025 5.

Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioner above-named be released on bail provisionally for four months on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned CJM, Sitamarhi in connection with Nanpur P.S. Case No. 280 of 2023.
